operations.title: Entry 1407 — Degree Reversal Polarizes the Xi Jet Boundary
operations.summary: On the associated graded of each Xi local algebra, residue duality pairs complementary jet degrees. Canonical degree reversal and Weil normalization give the positive Gram matrix mI. The resulting entire-quotient boundary has the exact Xi determinant and is self-adjoint iff RH.

operations.title: Degree reversal gives a positive Weil-compatible polarization of the graded Xi jet quotient
operations.statement: For Xi=u_lambda t^m+..., the graded residue form is u_lambda^-1 delta_(i+j,m-1). The canonical reversal C e_j=u_lambda e_(m-1-j) makes h=m R(.,C.) have Gram matrix mI, agreeing with the Weil weight on the value line. Completing the graded entire-function quotient yields a compact-resolvent diagonal operator with Xi determinant, self-adjoint exactly under RH.
operations.scope: Conditional CCM entire-quotient boundary; does not prove RH, density of the original compactly supported Mellin test family in all jets, or a physical chain pushforward.

operations.title: Double-zero graded-residue polarization test
operations.description: For residue matrix R=[[0,u^-1],[u^-1,0]] and degree reversal C=[[0,u],[u,0]], verify 2RC=2I and compare with a nonreal spectral value.
